'''Folashade Sherifat Jaji''' (born 10 March 1957) is a Nigerian [[chemist]], civil servant and the Secretary to Lagos State Government.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://lagosstate.gov.ng/blog/2019/05/30/governor-babajide-sanwo-olu-makes-1st-appointment-names-mrs-folashade-sherifat-jaji-former-head-of-service-as-secretary-to-the-state-government/|title=GOVERNOR BABAJIDE SANWO-OLU MAKES 1ST APPOINTMENT. NAMES MRS. FOLASHADE SHERIFAT JAJI, FORMER HEAD OF SERVICE AS SECRETARY TO THE STATE GOVERNMENT.|website=Lagos State Government|language=en-US|access-date=2019-05-31|archive-date=2019-05-31|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190531065230/https://lagosstate.gov.ng/blog/2019/05/30/governor-babajide-sanwo-olu-makes-1st-appointment-names-mrs-folashade-sherifat-jaji-former-head-of-service-as-secretary-to-the-state-government/|url-status=dead}}</ref> She was formerly the Head of Service in Lagos State,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://newtelegraphonline.com/hos-lauds-stakeholders-as-lagos-pays-n31-9bn-to-retirees/|title=New Telegraph – HoS lauds stakeholders as Lagos pays N31.9bn to retirees|author=Our Correspondent|work=newtelegraphonline.com|access-date=2015-04-16|archive-url=https://archive.today/20150416165452/http://newtelegraphonline.com/hos-lauds-stakeholders-as-lagos-pays-n31-9bn-to-retirees/|archive-date=2015-04-16|url-status=dead}}</ref>
a post she held after service as the Permanent Secretary, [[Lagos State Ministry of Establishments, Training and Pensions]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mynewswatchtimesng.com/expert-warns-retirees-on-extravagancy/|title=Expert warns retirees on extravagancy|author=ZAKA KHALIQ|work=Newswatch Times|access-date=2015-04-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160703224334/http://www.mynewswatchtimesng.com/expert-warns-retirees-on-extravagancy/|archive-date=2016-07-03|url-status=dead}}</ref> She also helped the federal government to improve the civil service fund reserve.

==Early life==
Sherifat was born on March 3, 1957, in [[Surulere]], a metropolitan city of [[Lagos State]], southwestern [[Nigeria]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lagosstatenews.com/news/fashola-appoints-sherifat-jaji-18th-lagos-head-of-service-leadership-newspapers|title=Fashola Appoints Sherifat Jaji 18th Lagos Head Of Service - Leadership Newspapers|work=lagosstatenews.com}}</ref>
She attended Anglican Girls Primary School in Surulere, lagos before she proceeded to Queen's College in Yaba, where she obtained the West Africa School Certificate in 1974.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cityvoiceng.com/fashola-swears-in-new-head-of-service/|title=This website is currently unavailable.|work=cityvoiceng.com}}{{Dead link|date=December 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
She received a Bachelor of Science degree from the [[University of Ibadan]], where she was trained as a chemist before she enrolled for a Post Graduate Diploma in Public Administration at [[Administrative Staff College of Nigeria]] after she completed the compulsory one year [[National Youth Service Corps|Youth Service]] at the [[Nigerian Breweries]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://factualtimes.com/meet-lagos-new-head-of-service/|title=Meet Lagos New Head of Service|work=factualtimes.com|access-date=2015-04-16|archive-date=2022-10-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221024234805/http://factualtimes.com/meet-lagos-new-head-of-service/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
Having completed the diploma program in 1985, she proceeded to the [[University of Lagos]] where she received a [[Master of Business Administration]]'s degree in 1989.<ref>{{Cite news |url=http://www.dailytrust.com.ng/daily/news/47189-fashola-appoints-new-hos |title=Fashola appoints new HOS |access-date=2015-04-16 |archive-date=2016-03-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303222238/http://www.dailytrust.com.ng/daily/news/47189-fashola-appoints-new-hos |url-status=dead |newspaper=[[Daily Trust]]}}</ref>

==Civil Service==
She joined the [[Lagos State Civil Service]] on 27 October 1980 at the state Judicial Service Commission before she was deployed to the state Governor's Office, Department of Political Affairs where she served for two years, between 1980 and 1982, the same year she got a transfer to the state civil service commission where she spent another two years before she returned to the Military Governor's Office at the Department of Programs and Budget where she spent seven years, between 1985 and 1992.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://starconnectmedia.com/2015/02/20/sherifat-folashade-jaji-becomes-lagos-head-of-service/|title=Sherifat Folashade Jaji Becomes Lagos Head of Service|work=starconnectmedia.com|access-date=2015-04-16|archive-date=2015-03-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150325234651/http://starconnectmedia.com/2015/02/20/sherifat-folashade-jaji-becomes-lagos-head-of-service/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-west/177103-fashola-swears-in-new-head-of-service.html|title=Fashola swears in new Head of Service|date=2015-02-18|access-date=2017-12-22|language=en-GB|newspaper=[[Premium Times]]}}</ref>

In November 2008, she was appointed Permanent Secretary, Teachers’ Establishment and Pensions Office, a position she held for four years.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://leadership.ng/news/412222/fashola-appoints-sherifat-jaji-18th-lagos-head-of-service|title=Fashola Appoints Sherifat Jaji 18th Lagos Head Of Service|author=Leadership Newspaper|date=17 February 2015|newspaper=[[Leadership (newspaper)|Leadership]]}}</ref>
On&nbsp;1 March 2011 she became the Permanent Secretary, [[Lagos State Ministry of Establishments, Training and Pensions]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.vanguardngr.com/2011/02/fashola-appoints-4-new-permanent-secretaries/|location=Lagos, Nigeria|title=Fashola appoints 4 new Permanent Secretaries|newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]}}</ref>
On 17 February 2015, she was appointed as Lagos State Head of Service to succeed [[Josephine Oluseyi Williams]], who was the 17th Head of Service of the State Public Service<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thegazellenews.com/2015/02/17/lagos-unveils-new-head-of-service-sherifat-folashade-jaji/|title=Lagos Unveils New Head Of Service, Sherifat Folashade Jaji|work=The Gazelle News|access-date=2015-04-16|archive-date=2020-07-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200721055152/http://www.thegazellenews.com/2015/02/17/lagos-unveils-new-head-of-service-sherifat-folashade-jaji/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://thenewsnigeria.com.ng/2015/02/16/lagos-names-another-female-head-of-service/|title=Lagos names another female head of service|work=The NEWS}}</ref>

On 30 May 2019, Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu appointed Jaji as Secretary to the State Government (SSG).<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://punchng.com/sanwo-olu-appoints-ex-hos-folasade-jaji-as-new-ssg/|title=Sanwo-Olu appoints ex-HoS Folasade Jaji as new SSG|newspaper=[[The Punch]]|language=en-US|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref>
